full_prompt_en: A square mixed-media drawing shows an oversized pink rose resting across a loosely sketched bed in a pale room. The paper remains mostly warm off-white, with the room suggested by thin, searching blue and occasional pink lines rather than fully painted walls. At the left rear, a squared headboard and a pillow are built from overlapping dark cobalt strokes. A few sketchy vertical and horizontal marks imply a window or wall opening behind the bed, leaving wide areas of the background unfilled. The mattress spreads diagonally from the upper left toward the lower right, its rumpled white cover defined by restless blue crosshatching and folds. Near the center-right, the rose becomes the clearest and most saturated shape. Layered magenta and deep rose strokes curl inward around its dark center, and broad pale pink petal edges catch light. A dark green leaf rises behind the bloom, while a short stem and another leaf stretch left across the bedding. Beneath the mattress, slim bed legs and a deep blue shadow give the object a precarious but readable place in the room. Rapid diagonal hatching continues across the floor at the bottom, intersected by a few light pink construction-like marks. The rose is more filled and rounded than the furniture; the bed remains visibly provisional, with multiple contour attempts and unclosed lines. Light is broad and even from above, implied by the white paper on the bedding and lighter petal rims rather than by a strong cast shadow. The overall composition sets one vivid, fully colored bloom against an open field of scratchy blue drawing, making the contrast between lush color and unfinished line the central visual event.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形混合媒介素描描绘一朵尺寸夸张的粉玫瑰横放在浅色房间里的一张速写床上。纸面大多保留暖灰白，房间只由细小、反复试探的蓝线和偶尔的粉线暗示，墙面并未完全上色。左后方，方形床头板与枕头由重叠的深钴蓝笔触搭建。床后少量草率的横竖线暗示窗或墙面开口，背景仍有大片空白。床垫从左上斜展向右下，凌乱白色被单由躁动的蓝色交叉排线与褶皱勾出。靠近中央偏右处，玫瑰成为最清楚、最饱和的形体。洋红和深玫瑰色层叠笔触围着深色花心向内卷曲，宽阔浅粉花瓣边缘接住光。一片深绿叶在花朵后立起，短茎和另一片叶子向左横在被单上。床垫下方，细床腿与深蓝阴影让物件在房间中有略显不稳却可读的位置。快速斜向排线延续至下方地板，间有少量浅粉色、近似起稿的痕迹。玫瑰比家具更饱满圆润；床则明显保持临时起稿状态，有多次尝试的轮廓与未闭合线条。光线从上方宽泛而均匀地落下，通过床单上的纸白和较浅花瓣边缘暗示，而非强烈投影。整体构图以一朵鲜艳且充分着色的花，对照大片粗涩蓝色素描，让丰沛色彩与未完成线条之间的差异成为中心视觉事件。
style_prompt_en: The image has the immediacy of a mixed-media sketch: loose cobalt contour lines, restless crosshatching, open paper, and a concentrated area of rich pigment. Most forms remain partially constructed through repeated strokes and visible corrections, while one saturated region receives smoother, layered modeling. Warm off-white space is dominant, deep blue marks provide structure and shadow, and magenta or green accents arrive in small, forceful areas. Line density increases beneath and around the focal mass, creating weight without enclosing every plane. Light reads as broad and even, with brightness supplied by exposed paper and pale gaps between marks. The overall treatment is raw, expressive, and airy, using the imbalance between a vivid painted accent and provisional drawing as its rhythm.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有混合媒介速写的即时感：松散钴蓝轮廓线、躁动交叉排线、开放纸白，以及一处浓郁颜料的集中区域。大多数形体由反复笔触和可见修改部分搭成，只有一个饱和区域获得较平滑的层叠塑形。暖灰白空间占主导，深蓝线条提供结构和阴影，洋红或绿色重音以小而有力的面积出现。线条密度在焦点体块下方和周围增加，不闭合每个平面仍建立重量。光感宽泛均匀，亮度来自裸露纸面和笔迹之间的浅色空隙。整体处理粗粝、富表现力且通透，以鲜明绘画重音与临时性素描的不均衡形成节奏。
theme_en: A large pink rose resting across a loosely sketched bed
theme_zh: 一朵硕大的粉玫瑰横放在松散速写的床上
name: Tracey Emin
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
